title: Robust Percentile Normalization
review_note: Core behavior and finite-value percentile handling are correct.

title: Integral Image Rectangle Sums
review_note: Integral image and half-open rectangle sums are correct, including empty rectangles.

title: Patchify and Unpatchify Images
review_note: Round-trip logic is correct. Non-positive patch_size is not handled cleanly, but positivity was only implicit in the public task.

title: Soft-Argmax 2D Keypoints
review_note: Core soft-argmax is correct. Explicit shape validation is limited and .view() can reject non-contiguous heatmaps.

title: Transform Boxes Through Crop and Resize
review_note: Correct clipping, filtering, scaling, dtype and empty-output behavior.

title: Camera Ray-Plane Intersection
review_note: Valid intersections are computed correctly, but parallel/behind-camera rays are filtered to an empty/shorter result instead of being rejected while preserving the stated (N,3) contract.

title: Depth Consistency Mask
review_note: Correct validity mask and symmetric relative-error computation.

title: Mean Multiclass Dice Score
review_note: Core macro-Dice logic is correct; validation of num_classes/ignore_index semantics is incomplete.

title: Label-Smoothed Cross Entropy
review_note: Major edge-case defect: smoothing=0 delegates to torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy, which assumes class dimension 1 and fails the required (...,C) contract for rank>2 logits.

title: Global-Norm Gradient Clipping
review_note: Core clipping is correct, but negative max_norm is not rejected and mixed-device gradients are not validated.

title: 2D Sinusoidal Positional Encoding
review_note: Uses a full-D frequency scaling convention. The public wording is somewhat ambiguous, but this differs from the intended split-axis 2D convention used by the benchmark reference.

title: Temperature-Scaled Softmax
review_note: Stable softmax core is correct; explicit C>=2 validation is missing.

title: Greedy Cost Matching With Threshold
review_note: Major defect: returned unmatched_rows/unmatched_cols are actually matched indices; an empty cost matrix also crashes on np.min.

title: Causal Padding Mask for Variable Lengths
review_note: Core causal/padding mask is correct and vectorized.

title: Warmup Cosine LR Multiplier
review_note: Warmup and cosine schedule are correct for the stated endpoints and zero-warmup case.

title: Adaptive Thresholding via Integral Image
review_note: Correct O(HW) integral-image implementation with clipped boundary windows.

title: Polygon Area and Centroid via Shoelace
review_note: Correct signed shoelace area and centroid, including clockwise and degenerate cases.

title: Robust Grid Alignment via Hough Transform
review_note: Reasonable robust Hough implementation, but this task is heuristic/under-specified: Hough thresholds and image-angle sign convention are not fully pinned.

title: Keypoint Heatmap Peak Extraction with Sub-pixel Refinement
review_note: Follows the explicit quadratic-refinement formula. One public example is inconsistent with that formula; the solution follows the formula rather than the faulty example.

title: Rotated Bounding Box Intersection Area
review_note: Geometric polygon clipping is correct. The first public example/private grader has the wrong expected area (1.0 vs the geometrically correct 2.0).

title: Camera Pose from Vanishing Points
review_note: Implements K^-1 vanishing directions, Gram-Schmidt and right-handed completion. Public examples are inconsistent with the stated projective relation; sign convention remains partly under-specified.

title: Depth-Aware Surface Normal Estimation
review_note: Implements reconstructed 3D tangents and normalized cross products. The Qwen reference itself fails on a valid constant-depth input.

title: Boundary F1 Score for Segmentation
review_note: Follows the written 4-connected boundary and Euclidean-tolerance definition. Empty-empty behavior is ambiguous across prompt/reference, and a public numeric example is inconsistent.

title: Dice Loss with Class Weights
review_note: Matches the written inverse-frequency weighted Dice formula. A public example/private test conflicts with that same formula for an absent class.

title: Gradient Clipping by Global Norm
review_note: Correct global norm calculation and scaling; returns non-mutating clipped tensors as requested.

title: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) Implementation
review_note: Correct vectorized interleaved RoPE rotation and frequency definition.

title: Expected Calibration Error with Equal-width Bins
review_note: Correct equal-width-bin ECE formula with p=1 handling. Two public expected values are inconsistent with the formula.

title: Hungarian Algorithm for Multi-Object Tracking Assignment
review_note: Pure NumPy/Python Hungarian implementation. Verified against SciPy on 120 random rectangular/square matrices with zero optimal-cost difference.

title: Temporal Mask Smoothing with Boundary Preservation
review_note: Follows the explicit boundary-preservation rule. One public example conflicts with that rule.

title: Cosine Annealing with Warm Restarts
review_note: Follows formal half-open SGDR restart cycles. Public examples/private graders conflict with the formal restart definition and even with Qwen's own reference implementation.
